scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @fsm/server" "npm run dev -w @fsm/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fsm/shared && npm run build -w @fsm/client && npm run build -w @fsm/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fsm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @fsm/client && npm run typecheck -w @fsm/server
